<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/v1/keys/{id}"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>

</MethodEndpoint>



Never includes key secrets or hashes. Returns 404 (not 403) when
the id exists but is owned by another caller, so key existence is
not leaked across owners.
